justification: Widens the dcp_review_queue status CHECK to include 'superseded' - the value PR #830's supersede path and the triage flow write. Found via a live CheckViolation; the constraint predates the value. Additive widening, no rows affected.
functions: N/A - SQL migration only, no functions.

break_it.scenario: PR #830's re-extraction hits a chapter with rejected rows and the supersede UPDATE violates the old constraint, crashing the Monday cron mid-run.
break_it.what_happens: Extraction aborts for every subsequent chapter and the queue refresh is left partial.
break_it.how: Constraint widened and already applied to prod (verified via pg_get_constraintdef); the supersede UPDATE ran successfully against 4232 rows immediately after.
break_it.repro: UPDATE a queue row to status='superseded' - succeeds post-migration, CheckViolation before.

post_merge.db_reset: Migration already applied to prod and verified; merge records it in the repo.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - pg_get_constraintdef shows six statuses including superseded; 4232 rows carry the new status.
